evaluations.claim: Gastro-tuned variant achieves the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups
evaluations.reality: The fine-tuned variants show relatively similar performance within each group — there is no clear single variant that dominates. The bars within each specialty group are close in height for the fine-tuned models

evaluations.claim: Infect group shows the largest overall bar heights, with baseline reaching approximately -23.5
evaluations.reality: Cardio bars are overall taller (closer to -22), not Infect. Infect bars are actually shorter overall (more negative). The ranking of which group has tallest bars is inverted
evaluations.reason: Infect group has largest bar heights

evaluations.claim: Cardio group exhibits the smallest spread between baseline and fine-tuned variants at roughly 1.5 units
evaluations.reality: Cardio actually shows bars that are taller overall (closer to -22) and the spread claim is fabricated — the spread appears similar across groups
